Daily comment posted to [#2529](https://github.com/vamseeachanta/workspace-hub/issues/2529#issuecomment-4370996048).

`✶ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
- **Pagination caveat is real**: the Gmail MCP caps pages at 50 and returns a `nextPageToken` whenever more results exist — unread counts reported as "50+" are lower bounds, not totals. The only day a low unread was reliably reported (Apr 29 "14") had no continuation token, so it was a genuine full-page count.
- **Label query encoding gap**: `label:O&G-Industry` consistently fails because the `&` is treated as a query operator. The May 2 workaround (`label:O-G-Industry`) gave ≥50 — worth noting in the runbook as a known MCP gotcha.
- **7-day streak on same recommendation**: the XML import (`docs/email/gmail-filters-2026-04-27.xml`) has been the single unlock for Criteria 1 and 2 every day since Apr 28. The AutoNoise and CRE labels are healthy from *pre-existing* broader filters — the runbook-specific Group 1–3 senders (turiya, sahil, openai, godaddy, zillow) are still hitting inbox unread.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

Comment posted for 2026-05-04. Blockers unchanged: install the XML filter import to clear Groups 1–2 newsletter noise (~9 threads/7d) and that single action resolves both Criterion 1 (unread < 25) and Criterion 2 (≥5 rules active).
